failures.error: speech transcription failed: part 1 could not be completed: speech decode failed: decoding stopped before completion (duration_token_limit); incomplete transcription was discarded

limitations: Corpus references simulate explicit confirmation; no user database or private audio was used.
Svarah grouping is a recording proxy, not a verified speaker-disjoint split.
Strict WER splits punctuation and does not normalize spoken digit sequences to numeric IDs.
Failed samples remain in coverage but have no WER denominator.
Environment threads=8 is the application worker cap; NeMo native graph thread count is unknown.
Calibration process metrics were unavailable because macOS time -l was denied a system query after inference completed.
20 ms paced prerecorded replay excludes microphone, UI, insertion, endpoint/word-emission timestamps and continuous power/thermal telemetry.
Native decoder, model weights, model defaults, and inference ownership were unchanged.
